config.role: Exploratory matched-comparator fallback after both previous outer reports were inspected; not independent confirmation
config.hypothesis: A fixed midpoint between original summed-feedback and conditional task-balanced posterior retains frequent-goal quality while preserving sparse-goal gains; test identically in both arms

initialization.anchor: Original selected EMER for the same fold and seed, already trained without those outer users
initialization.both_arms: Copy the identical anchor and zero the28 Jev projection columns; only use_jev differs

training.posterior: 0.5 times the original EMER summed-feedback pair loss plus0.5 times the conditional task-balanced pair loss. Original sample weights in both terms. No coefficient search.
training.prior: Keep original EMER behavior-prior pair loss and epoch-snapshot advantage weights; same fixed coefficient in both arms

selection.data: Inner validation only, never outer rows
selection.anchor: Same fixed original EMER per fold and seed for both arms
selection.admissible: All six positive and no-hate point changes versus anchor at least -0.005
selection.criterion: Maximize six-positive mean among admissible epochs; epoch0 anchor is included; earliest tie wins

evaluation.primary_comparison: Balanced EMER+Jev versus identically balanced EMER
evaluation.reference_comparison: Balanced EMER+Jev versus original frozen EMER
evaluation.screen: For both comparisons: positive pooled primary conditional CI, positive primary point change in every seed and fold, and all seven original point guards
evaluation.report: All seven objectives, every fold/seed, support, selected epochs and all fallback-to-anchor cases

limitations: This training recipe is an EMER adaptation; changes shared by both arms cannot be attributed to Jev.
The cohort and its outer results were already explored. New results remain exploratory even if all conditions pass.
Conditional bootstrap does not capture all training variation; folds overlap in their training users.
No claim of new-date confirmation, strict all-objective dominance, or online business uplift.
The blend was proposed from already-observed inner guard failures after both earlier outer reports were opened; this is another exploratory test.
This is a new deployment/selection policy, not a correction that changes earlier registered results.
All previous outer data and results were already explored; these estimates are exploratory and need independent confirmation.
Reported benefits are conditional offline ranking estimates, not online causal uplift or universal training uncertainty.
A fallback has exactly zero Jev increment for that model slot; no zero is counted as a strict positive gain.
